0022600221.text: The Grizzlies (7-3) host the Nuggets (5-4) in Memphis's 11th game of the season. Memphis enters on a one-game winning streak, 3rd in the Southwest and 1.5 games back, and 7th in the West, after going 5-0 on the road but 2-3 at home. Denver, 3-2 on the road and 2-2 at home, is on a one-game losing streak, 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West. Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (knee, surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness), and Isaiah Stewart (knee, bruise) and Quinten Post (head) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Julian Strawther (knee, sprain) is out for Denver; the teams have not met yet this season, and Memphis lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-119 loss in Denver in April.
